F04_einstein_label.verdict: MISLABEL (FAILS as an attribution). The vacuum Einstein equations are R_mn = 0; their spherically symmetric solution is the Schwarzschild metric, ds^2 = -(1-2M/r)c^2 dt^2 + (1-2M/r)^-1 dr^2 + r^2(d(theta)^2 + sin^2(theta) d(phi)^2). The identity 1/sin^2(theta) - cot^2(theta) = 1 appears nowhere in the equations or the solution; the only theta in Schwarzschild is the polar coordinate, whose sin^2 rides as a metric coefficient in dOmega^2 — a neighbour, not the identity. Second coordinate: '(at the centre of every black hole)' names r = 0, the singularity, where the Schwarzschild solution itself ceases to describe spacetime points. The equation is honoured (F-03 stands); the attribution is corrected; neither is argued down beyond the proof named.
